android.note: The phone app talks to YTM Starcast on your computer: install that with Orbit for desktop.
android.extra: Includes your Discord status (formerly YTM Beacon): its controls are in YTM Starcast's app.

apps.name: Nova
apps.blurb: Secure remote for your home server

android.note: The Nova app pairs with a Nova server on Linux or Windows: Nova Server on that computer (or sudo nova add) shows the code.
android.extra: Comes with five home-screen widgets: status, live stats, quick actions, inbox and storage. In Nova: Menu → Home-screen widgets.
